what_this_is: the second reading of every wave-42 child under the CANONICAL standard, taken after the seals were written and against the same frozen dossiers.  The canonical lens forgives an ARTIFACT -- a cap-ride, a loop, a word substitution -- where the lane's substantive ask is nevertheless answered.  It does NOT forgive a lane that returns the prompt itself, because a copy-back is not a decode failure, it is the absence of a decode.  The clauses are quoted unchanged from waves 21, 23, 24, 38, 40 and 41; nothing here is a stricter or a looser standard invented this wave.
